item.title: Protests in Europe: Fact-checking viral videos amid claims of 'chaos'
item.description: As young people protest poor school conditions and the rising cost of living across Europe, misleading videos are spreading online. item.description: The European Union will from Sunday slap a €2 (US$2.25) handling fee on packages from outside the 27-nation bloc in a bid to curb the influx from China. item.description: At least two people were killed and 17 injured in a Ukrainian drone attack on Russia's Voronezh region. Flames engulfed buildings, while falling debris struck a commuter train. Publicado también por: Euronews. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: Brazil: What does Lula's re-election mean for the Amazon?
item.description: Climate activists in Brazil are celebrating President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's election victory as good news for the Amazon rainforest. His last four years in power saw a record decrease in deforestation in the world's largest rainforest. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Opponents accuse Netanyahu of stoking tensions with Iran before Israel's election
item.description: Israel's defence minister denied on Monday (October 26) reports of a rift between PM Netanyahu and the army over Iran, before the vote. Netanyahu has campaigned heavily on his security credentials, insisting only he can "finish the job" in the US-Israeli war on Iran. His main rival, ex-army chief Gadi Eisenkot, has accused him of playing up the Iran threat when it suits him politically, and of failing to accomplish his war goals. FRANCE 24's Kethevane Gorjestani tells us more. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Pope in 'good health' and trip to South America will go ahead as planned
item.description: The Pope is recovering well from cancer surgery and his trip to South America will go ahead as planned next month, the Vatican has said. Fuente: Sky News - World.
